target.generation_structure: PDB 11QC chain A cropped to residues 189-383

reference_interface.source: PDB 11RN / Lee et al. Nature Communications 2026

strategy_notes: Families 1 and 2 bias generation toward conserved/adjacent apical positions rather than the strongly species-variable Tyr211-centred footprint.
Family 3 intentionally samples the experimentally validated functional footprint despite species-variable residues.
pH selectivity is engineered and ranked after backbone/sequence generation; RFdiffusion itself is not treated as a pH predictor.
All generated sequences must later be screened against both full human and full mouse TfR1 constructs.
Proteinbase challenge hotspot correspondences override naive sequence alignment near the 202-215 indel.
